Container.Name: Immich-Tagger
Container.Overview: Immich Tagger scans photo folders, sends images to an Ollama vision model, and writes Immich-friendly XMP sidecars plus JSON diagnostics. It is designed for Unraid/Docker photo-library workflows with dry runs, retry/fallback model handling, and detailed run logs.
Container.Requires: External Ollama server reachable from the container. Photo library mapped to /photos. Persistent config mapped to /config.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Immich Tagger web UI.

Config.Name: Photo Library
Config.Description: Host photo library or Immich external-library share. The container sees this as /photos and writes XMP sidecars next to images.

Config.Name: App Config
Config.Description: Persistent Immich Tagger configuration, logs, and local secrets. Do not map this to a media folder.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Container user ID. For typical Unraid media writes use 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Container group ID. For typical Unraid media writes use 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask. 000 matches the permissive media-sidecar workflow used by the server library.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for logs and UI timestamps.

Config.Name: Photo Root
Config.Description: Container path used as the root for selectable/scannable photos.

Config.Name: Config Root
Config.Description: Container path for persistent app configuration.

Config.Name: Log Root
Config.Description: Container path for persistent web/server logs.

Config.Name: Primary Ollama URL
Config.Description: Primary Ollama server URL reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Primary Model
Config.Description: Primary Ollama vision model. qwen2.5vl:7b is the preferred high-quality model when available.

Config.Name: Max Image Size
Config.Description: Longest-edge resize before sending to the primary model. 0 means original/full resolution.

Config.Name: Fallback Enabled
Config.Description: Enable fallback model/server attempts after eligible primary failures.

Config.Name: Fallback Ollama URL
Config.Description: Fallback Ollama server URL reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Fallback Model
Config.Description: Fallback Ollama vision model. MiniCPM-V is useful for Unraid compatibility but lower quality than Qwen 7B.

Config.Name: Fallback Max Image Size
Config.Description: Longest-edge resize before sending to the fallback model. 0 means original/full resolution.

Config.Name: Dry Run Default
Config.Description: Default new runs to dry-run preview mode for safety.

Config.Name: Model Log
Config.Description: Keep optional .photoai.json model diagnostic sidecars for review and troubleshooting. Leave false for normal Immich XMP-only output.

Config.Name: Write XMP
Config.Description: Write Immich-compatible .jpg.xmp sidecars next to images.

Config.Name: Add Tags
Config.Description: Write AI-generated tags/keywords to XMP. Tags are the primary value of Immich Tagger.

Config.Name: Overwrite Sidecars Default
Config.Description: Default overwrite behavior for existing JSON/XMP sidecars. Keep false until intentionally reprocessing.
